entities.summary: Mariam Usman is a Nigerian weightlifter. She competes in the women's +75 kg class, where she is a four-time African Champion and gold medalist at the Commonwealth Games. She also won a bronze medal at the 2011 World Weightlifting Championships and has competed in three editions of the Olympic Games, winning a bronze medal in 2008. Mariam Usman has been confirmed as the first Nigerian athlete to compete in the inaugural Enhanced Games.
